name: letshunt-push-server
description: Push notification server for LetsHunt PWA — checks weather and sends Web Push alerts for cold fronts, baro shifts, rain breaks, and prime hunting days even when the app is closed.

scripts.generate-vapid: node -e "import('web-push').then(wp => { const k = wp.generateVAPIDKeys(); require('fs').writeFileSync('vapid.json', JSON.stringify(k, null, 2)); console.log('VAPID keys written to vapid.json'); })"
